MINUTES
  MALIBU  ARTS  COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  FEBRUARY 24, 2026
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Jones called the meeting to order at 9:34 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Vice Chair Peter Jones; Commissioners Lotte Cherin, Maureen Haldeman,
  Pamela Conley Ulich, and Dennis Smith

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried
  unanimously.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported that the meeting agenda was properly posted
  on February l9, 2026.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Election of Chair and Vice Chair

  Commissioner Cherin nominated Vice Chair Jones to serve as Chair. She stated
  Vice Chair Jones has stepped into the role of Chair since Mr. Haldeman’s vacancy.

  Commissioner Smith nominated himself for Chair.

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua closed nominations for Chair.

  The question was called, and the Commission voted 3-1-1 in favor of Vice Chair
  Jones as Chair; Commissioner Smith voted for himself, and Commissioner Conley
  Ulich abstained.

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua opened the floor for nominations for Vice
  Chair.

  Chair Jones nominated Commissioner Cherin for Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Smith nominated himself for Vice Chair.

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua closed nominations for Vice Chair.

  The question was called, and the Commission voted 3—1-1 in favor of
  Commissioner Cherin as Vice Chair; Commissioner Smith voted for himself, and
  Commissioner Conley Ulich abstained.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua stated that written correspondence was
  received from Mr. Scott Dittrich, the correspondence was emailed to the
  Commissioners and a hard copy was provided at the meeting.

  In response to Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo clarified that Mr.
  Dittrich’s correspondence was referring to Las Flores Creek Park.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  l.  Arts in Education

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry
  workshops at Malibu Elementary School and Malibu High School. She
  stated that staff had begun working on the student poetry and art anthology.

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Community Services Director
  Riesgo stated the students’ artwork was revealed at the annual Poetry
  Summit in May and would be promoted online after the reveal.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions
  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on the Student Art
  Exhibition. She stated the art exhibition featuring Gay Summer Rick would
  be displayed from March 23 through May 1, and an opening reception
  would be on Sunday, March 22.

  U).  Business and Community Outreach

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated the Year of Love, Hope, and Healing
  was successful.

  4.  Social Media

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Community Services Director
  Riesgo, she could research social media analytics and provide it to the
  Commission for review.

  5.  Community Resilience Proiect

  The update would be provided during Item 5.B.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

  None.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Malibu Arts Commission Rules of Procedure and Decorum
  Recommended Action: 1) Review the Malibu Arts Commission Rules of
  Procedure and Decorum; and 2) Recommend revisions for adoption by Resolution
  at the next Regular Commission meeting.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Cherin stated it was important that elections take place with the
  entire Commission present.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated that the Commission was violating the Rules of
  Procedure and Decorum because elections were held during this meeting instead of
  in June.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that Section 5 of the Rules of
  Procedure and Decorum allows the Commission to suspended the rules by a
  majority vote. She recommended to add the allowance of filling a vacancy in
  Section 1.1.B.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich suggested to revise Section 1.1.B. to, “The
  Commission shall hold an election in June and/or as necessary due to unforeseen
  absences.”

  Commissioner Smith stated that elections could occur as long as four members of
  the Commission were present.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes 0f February 24, 2026
  Page 4 of 6

  Chair Jones indicated agreement with Commissioner Smith.

MOTION  Commissioner Smith moved, and Chair Jones seconded a motion to revise Section
  1.1.B. of the Rules of Procedure and Decorum regarding Election of Officers to
  state “The Commission shall hold an election at its regular meeting in June of each
  year to select a Chair and Vice Chair from its membership. If the full Commission
  is not in attendance, at least four members of the Commission shall be present, or
  the election shall be continued to the next Regular Commission meeting.” The
  motion carried 4-1; Commissioner Cherin dissenting.

  Community Services Director Riesgo clarified whether the vacancy verbiage had
  been approved for inclusion in the rules.

FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Commissioner Smith amended the motion to revise Section 1.1.B of the Rules of
  Procedure and Decorum regarding Election of Officers to state, “The Commission
  shall hold an election at its Regular meeting in June of each year to select a Chair
  and Vice Chair from its membership, or sooner, in the event of an unplanned
  vacancy. If the full Commission is not in attendance, at least four members of the
  Commission shall be present, or the election shall be continued to the next Regular
  Commission meeting.” The seconder accepted the amendment. The question was
  called, and the motion carried 4-1; Commissioner Cherin dissenting.

MOTION  Commissioner Conley Ulich moved, and Chair Jones seconded a motion to suspend
  the rules for the Election of Officers since Elections were held during the February
  24, 2026 Malibu Arts Commission Regular meeting. The motion carried 4-1;
  Commissioner Smith dissenting.

  Malibu City Gallery Spring Art Exhibition
  Recommended Action: At the recommendation of the Malibu Public Arts
  Exhibitions Ad Hoc Committee, approve featured artists Jacquelyn Blue and
  JoAnne Unger for the spring Malibu City Gallery art exhibition.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated that both artists were great, have been painting for
  years, and have won multiple awards. She stated they had recently begun painting
  together on a single canvas.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated that it would be a unique experience to see their
  individual work and their joint artwork on display in the gallery.

MOTION  Vice Chair Cherin moved, and Chair Jones seconded a motion to approve Jacquelyn
  Blue and JoAnne Unger for the spring Malibu City Gallery art exhibition. The
  motion carried unanimously.

  Communitv Resiliency Mural 'Proiect
  Recommended Action: At the recommendation of the Community Resilience
  Project Ad Hoc Committee, approve artist Hunter Blaze Pearson to create the City
  of Malibu 35th Anniversary Mural Project

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staffreport.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated Hunter Blaze Pearson was a local artist and
  asked to incorporate cultural pieces into the mural.

  In response to Vice Chair Cherin, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  mural would be on canvas and displayed at the Michael Landon Center at Malibu
  Bluffs Park.

  In response to Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the City
  would own the mural upon completion.

MOTION  Vice Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Conley Ulich seconded a motion to
  approve Hunter Blaze Pearson to create the City of Malibu 35th Anniversary Mural
  Project. The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs and
  Chumash Day.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Chair Jones provided an update on his Commission report, presented at the
  February 23, 2026 City Council meeting.

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated that the longboarding surfing event idea discussed at the January 27, 2026
  Regular meeting was outside the Commission’s scope and the Community Services
  Department's purview and budget, as the event would involve multiple
  jurisdictions. She stated that further direction from the City Council would be
  required to move forward.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated that Ryan Keeley, known as “Keeley,” was an
  artist visiting Malibu from New York and would be interested in a solo exhibition
  at the Malibu City Gallery. She stated he was helping Malibu Urgent Care’s
  fundraising efforts.
